card.name: Hepatitis C and antiviral drug names
card.fires_on: The gap or slash right after a hepatitis C antiviral name (sofosbuvir, pibrentasvir, ledipasvir) before a dose figure. Also partway through other antiviral names such as ritonavir, remdesivir and VEKLURY.

modes.label: Gap or slash before dose
modes.description: A space or slash after an HCV antiviral name or strength, just before the next dose number.

modes.description: Partway through a longer antiviral brand or generic name.
